cases.difficulty_rationale: The defect appears only when bool/int equality is nested inside list or mapping enum values.
cases.environment_caveat: Python 3.12; import the checkout root directly; existing lightweight jsonschema runtime dependencies are sufficient.
cases.title: Wrong behaviour for enum keyword
cases.body: Nested enum values could accept 0 as False, or 1 as True, because container equality bypassed JSON Schema's type-sensitive equality.

cases.difficulty_rationale: ISO 24:00 is legal midnight notation but requires a calendar-day rollover, including month and leap-day boundaries.
cases.environment_caveat: Python 3.12; import the checkout root directly. The oracle isolates isoparser and supplies only the minimal six/tz namespace needed by the timezone-free case.
cases.title: Closes #658 Fix Isoparser misinterprets T24:00
cases.body: The ISO parser normalized hour 24 to hour 0 without advancing the date, so 24:00 referred to the wrong day.

cases.difficulty_rationale: None-valued slice bounds have direction-dependent meanings and must compose with the range's own step.
cases.environment_caveat: Python 3.12; import the checkout root directly; standard library only for this interface.
cases.title: Fix numeric_range slicing with negative step returning empty range
cases.body: numeric_range used forward-slice defaults even for negative steps, so reverse and other negative-step slices could become empty.

cases.difficulty_rationale: The parser appears complete, but Python's dollar anchor also matches immediately before one final newline.
cases.environment_caveat: Python 3.12; import the checkout's src directory directly.
cases.title: fix(parser): use a strict end-of-input anchor
cases.body: Requirement and marker tokenization used a regex end anchor that silently accepted a single trailing line feed.

cases.category: URL object construction and error handling
cases.difficulty_rationale: The failure occurs only when replace enters authority reconstruction for a URL whose netloc is empty.
cases.environment_caveat: Python 3.12; import the checkout root directly; no service or network access.
cases.title: Fix IndexError in URL.replace() on a URL with no authority
cases.body: URL.replace indexed the last character of an empty derived hostname when changing authority-related fields on path-only or file URLs.

cases.difficulty_rationale: Correct visible text is insufficient; ANSI background state must be terminated before each literal newline and restored afterward.
cases.environment_caveat: Python 3.12; import the checkout root directly and render to StringIO with forced standard color.
cases.title: fix background style with soft wrap
cases.body: Soft-wrapped console output applied background style across embedded newline terminators, causing terminal background bleed.

cases.difficulty_rationale: The sentinel must survive shallow copy, deep copy, and pickle round trips as the exact same object.
cases.environment_caveat: Python 3.12; import the checkout's src directory directly. The oracle isolates jinja2.utils and provides a deterministic minimal MarkupSafe namespace; sentinel behavior itself has no MarkupSafe dependency.
cases.title: Fix pickle/copy support for the `missing` singleton
cases.body: Jinja's dynamically created missing sentinel could not be pickled and copy operations did not preserve singleton identity.

cases.difficulty_rationale: The environment variable is non-empty before splitting but contains no usable entries after whitespace filtering.
cases.environment_caveat: Python 3.12; import the checkout's src directory directly. The oracle supplies deterministic generated version metadata and instantiates the Unix backend on Windows.
cases.title: fix: don't crash when an XDG dirs variable holds only separators
cases.body: Separator-only XDG directory lists were truthy before splitting but empty afterward, leading single-path properties to index an empty list.

cases.difficulty_rationale: Only an empty replacement stem combined with a non-empty suffix exposes the divergence from pathlib.
cases.environment_caveat: Python 3.12; import the checkout's src directory directly; the tested Path operation is synchronous and service-free.
cases.title: Fixed Path.with_stem() not validating an empty stem
cases.body: AnyIO reimplemented with_stem by concatenation and silently returned .txt for an empty stem instead of raising like pathlib.

cases.difficulty_rationale: The runtime field value has already passed through attrs' converter, while the declared default has not.
cases.environment_caveat: Python 3.12; import the checkout's src directory directly with the existing attrs dependency.
cases.title: Apply attrs' converter to default before omit_if_default check
cases.body: Generated unstructure hooks compared converted instance values against raw attrs defaults, so omit_if_default emitted fields that were semantically at default.
